name: Soda
summary: Run Soda Core scans on Ogun data inside a sandboxed Python code operator; with Soda Cloud keys, scan results are posted to Soda Cloud.

fields.name: api_key_id
fields.label: API key ID
fields.help: Created in Soda Cloud. Store it with ogun secrets set.

fields.name: api_key_secret
fields.label: API key secret
fields.help: Shown once when the key is created.

settings.name: cloud_host
settings.label: Soda Cloud host
settings.help: Soda Cloud region of your account. Only used with an API key.

egress.note: Soda Core scans reach the data source the scan names; add its host to the same egress approval.

notes: Ogun calls Soda; it does not replace it. A scan runs in the builtin python@1 code operator: out of process, sandboxed, referenced by content hash and approved by a person against the workflow hash. Ogun has no Soda-specific operator. With a Soda Cloud configuration, the Soda library posts results itself. Check the Soda documentation for your Soda Core version.
